<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':14}], intent='explore')

a = previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); b = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
diffs = [(i,j) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]!=b[i][j]]
if diffs:
    rs=[d[0] for d in diffs]; cs=[d[1] for d in diffs]
    print("changed cells:", len(diffs), "rows", min(rs), max(rs), "cols", min(cs), max(cs))
    seen=set()
    for i,j in diffs: seen.add((a[i][j],b[i][j]))
    print("transitions:", sorted(seen))
else:
    print("no cell changes")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
